archTIS Awarded A$445,000 Three-Year Spirion SDP Contract 2
										
                                            pages 115.5KB

analysis.what_happened: archTIS secured a A$445,000 three-year Spirion SDP contract with a U.S. private aviation company, covering software licensing, support, and professional services paid annually.
analysis.so_what: Small contract (A$445k over 3 years, ~A$148k/yr ARR) but strategically notable as it marks entry into commercial verticals beyond defence/government, with upsell potential into NC Protect and TDI; minimal valuation impact in isolation but supports the commercial diversification thesis.
